title: Spicy Chicken Bulgogi-Style Bowl
steps: Rinse the jasmine rice. Simmer 3/4 cup rice in 1 cup water until the grains are tender, about 12–14 minutes; cover and rest.
Cut bok choy into bite-size pieces. Mix soy–mirin blend, gochujang and sugar for the sauce; replace the blend and gochujang with halal-suitable alternatives if needed.
Toast sesame seeds dry in a skillet for 2–3 minutes. Stir-fry bok choy in some sesame oil until just tender.
Season chicken breasts with garlic salt. Sear in the remaining sesame oil until cooked through to 74°C.
Pour the sauce into the chicken pan and simmer briefly to coat and thicken.
Serve chicken and bok choy over rice and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.
halal: Use halal chicken; soy-mirin blend contains mirin flavouring and gochujang ingredient list includes alcohol: replace with halal-certified soy sauce, rice vinegar and chili paste.

title: Savoury Umami Chicken Bowls
steps: Simmer rice in water until tender, 12–14 minutes; keep covered.
Slice green onion, bok choy and zucchini. Cut chicken tenders in half.
Stir-fry bok choy and zucchini in a hot skillet with a little oil until lightly cooked; move aside.
Brown chicken on both sides until 74°C. Add the listed sauce/puree and a splash of water; use cornstarch mixed with cold water to thicken.
Fold in vegetables and spoon chicken and sauce over rice.
Top with green onion. Check the original HelloFresh page for the exact proprietary Szechuan sauce formulation, which the source ingredient listing labels inconsistently.
halal: Use halal chicken. Source lists ginger-garlic puree twice; verify product type and any sauce ingredients on recipe page.

title: Middle Eastern Lamb and Lentil Stew
steps: Chop mint and cilantro; mince garlic. Preheat oven to 230°C for the pita.
Sauté ground lamb, onion-celery blend and Indian spice mix until lamb is fully cooked to 71°C.
Add garlic and tomato sauce; stir for one minute, then add canned lentils with their liquid and a little water. Simmer until thick.
Stir yogurt with chopped mint, cilantro and vinegar (or lemon juice) for a herby sauce.
Brush pitas with a little oil and toast in the oven briefly.
Serve stew in bowls, spoon yogurt sauce on top and add warm pita wedges.
halal: Halal ground lamb required; substitute lemon juice for white wine vinegar if avoiding wine-derived ingredients.

title: Chimichurri Chicken Bowl
steps: Cook basmati rice with part of the cumin-turmeric blend until soft.
Cut pepper and half the red onion into strips; roast or broil with oil until slightly charred.
Season chicken with remaining cumin-turmeric spice and pan-cook until it reaches 74°C.
Finely dice tomato and remaining red onion; toss with part of the red wine vinegar (or lemon juice).
Mix cilantro, olive oil and remaining vinegar into a quick chimichurri.
Slice chicken and serve with rice, roasted vegetables, salsa and chimichurri.
halal: Use halal chicken. Replace red wine vinegar with lemon juice or a verified non-wine vinegar if desired.

title: Smart Harissa Chicken-and-Lentil Stew
steps: Chop onion and portion the squash, spinach, lentils and spices.
Brown ground chicken with onion and harissa seasoning until fully cooked to 74°C.
Add butternut squash, red lentils, tomato sauce base and verified halal chicken broth with enough water to simmer.
Cook gently until squash and lentils are tender; stir in spinach to wilt.
Top with a little yogurt and chopped cilantro if listed.
Serve the stew hot; refrigerate extra portions promptly.
halal: Use halal ground chicken and halal-certified chicken broth concentrate.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Cook basmati rice in water with garlic until tender and keep warm.
Cut chicken thighs into bite-size pieces and thinly slice the carrot. Rinse spinach.
Brown chicken in a non-stick pan and cook until the centre reaches 74°C.
Add carrot and curry paste; stir a minute, then pour in tikka sauce and cream and simmer gently.
Fold in spinach until wilted and season to taste.
Serve creamy chicken tikka over rice. Choose a halal-certified tikka sauce and paste.
halal: Use halal chicken; check tikka sauce and curry paste for alcohol-based flavourings.

title: Sheet Pan Chicken Tikka
steps: Heat oven to 220°C. Cut chicken, bell peppers and red onion into evenly sized pieces.
Toss chicken with Indian spice blend, garlic and curry paste; arrange on a lined sheet pan with peppers and onion.
Roast until vegetables soften and chicken reaches 74°C.
Warm naan separately; check naan and packaged tikka sauce for halal suitability.
Stir yogurt with a little cilantro and garlic for a cooling topping.
Finish chicken and vegetables with tikka sauce; serve with naan and yogurt.
halal: Use halal chicken and check curry paste/tikka sauce; inspect naan emulsifiers if strict halal compliance is needed.

title: Carb Smart Cajun Beef
steps: Dice bell peppers and celery. Chop green onion. Wash spring mix.
Combine Cajun seasoning with halal ground beef and cook in a hot skillet until no pink remains and beef reaches 71°C.
Add celery and pepper; sauté until tender-crisp.
Stir a small amount of halal-certified broth into the pan to bring flavours together.
Mix mayonnaise and hot sauce for a quick spicy dressing.
Serve beef and peppers with greens and drizzle dressing over the top; add lemon to taste.
halal: Use halal beef and beef broth; check mayo and hot sauce labels.

title: Lamb Curry
steps: Start basmati rice in a covered pot; cook until fluffy.
Chop onion and zucchini. Prepare garlic and ginger; drain the green peas.
Brown halal ground lamb in a pan until it reaches 71°C.
Add onion, garlic, ginger and tadka spice; stir until fragrant. Add diced tomatoes, zucchini and peas.
Simmer until vegetables are tender and sauce is reduced. Toast shredded coconut lightly in a dry pan.
Serve lamb curry over rice and finish with coconut and cilantro.
halal: Use halal ground lamb; inspect spice mix for non-halal additives.

title: Traditional Lamb Shepherd's Pie
steps: Boil chopped potatoes until tender; mash with sour cream and season to taste.
Sauté mirepoix and garlic in a skillet, then brown ground lamb to 71°C.
Add peas, tomato sauce and a dash of soy sauce. Simmer to combine.
Transfer filling to a baking dish, cover with mashed potatoes and sprinkle over grated cheese.
Bake until the top is golden and the filling is hot throughout.
Scatter green onion over the shepherd’s pie and serve.
halal: Use halal lamb; choose Parmesan made with microbial or vegetarian rennet.

title: English-Style Lamb Stew
steps: Roast or boil chopped potatoes until tender. Chop onion, carrot, mushrooms and parsley.
Brown ground lamb in a pot until it reaches 71°C; move to a plate.
Sauté onion, carrot, mushrooms and garlic in butter. Sprinkle in flour and cook for one minute.
Add tomato sauce, soy sauce, lamb and halal-certified broth. Simmer until the sauce thickens.
Add peas and cooked potatoes; heat through gently.
Top stew with chopped parsley and serve.
halal: Halal lamb and chicken broth required; check stock and sauces.

title: Bulgogi-Style Beef Bowls
steps: Cook jasmine rice until fluffy. Prepare coleslaw mix and grate or slice pear.
Combine beef with egg, seasoning and a little soy sauce; form small meatballs.
Pan-cook meatballs until browned and cooked through to 71°C.
Make sauce with ginger-garlic puree, soy sauce, vinegar and brown sugar; thicken with cornstarch slurry.
Toss cooked meatballs in the sauce. Quickly season and dress cabbage and pear.
Serve saucy meatballs over rice with pear slaw and sesame seeds.
halal: Use halal beef. Source soy sauce ingredient listing contains alcohol; choose halal-certified soy sauce.

title: Spicy Chicken Thigh Bulgogi-Style Bowl
steps: Cook jasmine rice in 1 cup water until tender and let stand covered.
Cut bok choy; stir together soy-mirin blend, gochujang and sugar, using halal-suitable replacements where required.
Toast sesame seeds in a dry pan; cook bok choy briefly in sesame oil.
Season chicken thighs with garlic salt and pepper, then pan-fry until cooked through to 74°C.
Add sauce to chicken, simmer to coat and thicken slightly.
Serve with rice, bok choy and toasted sesame seeds.
halal: The original soy–mirin blend and gochujang may contain alcohol; replace with verified alcohol-free alternatives. Buy halal chicken.

title: Cal Smart Smoky Beef Meatballs
steps: Preheat oven to 220°C. Dice potatoes and toss with zesty garlic spice and oil; roast 22–25 minutes, turning once.
Combine ground beef, panko, half the feta, half the parsley and half the paprika-garlic blend. Form 12 meatballs.
Bake meatballs on a separate lined tray for 12–14 minutes or until the centres reach 71°C.
Dice red onion and zucchini. Sauté onion, edamame and corn, then add zucchini and remaining spice blend with a splash of water.
Combine roasted potatoes and vegetables to make a quick succotash.
Divide meatballs and vegetables between two plates; drizzle chipotle sauce and finish with feta and parsley.
halal: Use halal-certified ground beef. Check chipotle sauce, panko, feta rennet and spice blends.

title: Beef Taco Flatbread Pizzas
steps: Thinly slice green onions, chop tomatoes and zest and juice half the lime.
Toast flatbreads very briefly under a hot broiler so they soften without burning.
Brown ground beef with Mexican seasoning and half the green onions; cook to 71°C.
Spread flatbreads with marinara. Add beef and mozzarella, then broil until melted and golden.
Stir sour cream with lime juice for a quick crema; dress spring mix and tomatoes lightly.
Cut pizzas and serve with lime crema, remaining green onions and salad.
halal: Use halal ground beef and check the flatbread, marinara and mozzarella for halal suitability.

title: Smart Moroccan-Spiced Poached Salmon
steps: Thinly slice shallot, mince garlic, cut zucchini into half-moons and dice tomato; chop parsley.
Season salmon with salt, pepper and half the Moroccan spice blend.
Sauté shallot, garlic and zucchini in a little oil. Add remaining spice blend and heat briefly.
Stir in tomato sauce and chickpeas with their liquid; bring to a gentle simmer.
Nestle salmon into the sauce, cover and poach for 7–9 minutes until cooked to 70°C. Stir in diced tomato near the end.
Spoon chickpea-zucchini tagine into bowls and top with salmon and parsley.
halal: Check Moroccan spice blend and tomato sauce packaging for halal suitability.

title: Pesto Baked Salmon
steps: Preheat oven to 230°C. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Trim snap peas and halve tomatoes; chop parsley and zest lemon.
Cook pearl couscous until tender, about 6–8 minutes; drain.
Pat salmon dry and spread part of the pesto on the flesh. Bake on a lined sheet for about 6–10 minutes, until 70°C inside.
Sauté onion, snap peas and tomatoes until tender-crisp. Stir in garlic for the final minute.
Toss drained couscous into the pan with vegetables, lemon zest, parsley and remaining pesto.
Serve salmon over herby vegetable couscous with lemon wedges.
halal: Check pesto cheese for non-animal/microbial rennet and ensure packaged sauce contains no alcohol.

title: Soy-Maple Glazed Salmon
steps: Peel and cube sweet potatoes. Boil in salted water until tender, around 10–12 minutes.
Slice chives and trim snap peas. Pat salmon dry and season lightly.
Sauté snap peas in butter for 3–5 minutes and set aside.
Pan-sear salmon skin side down until golden, flip and finish to 70°C.
Simmer soy sauce and maple syrup with a little water until glossy. Drain and mash sweet potatoes with sour cream and remaining butter.
Serve salmon over sweet potato mash with snap peas, maple-soy glaze and chives.
halal: Use soy sauce verified free of added alcohol and check packaged sour cream.

title: Sheet Pan Shrimp Tacos
steps: Preheat oven to 220°C. Slice bell pepper and pat shrimp dry.
Toss pepper with oil on one side of a lined baking sheet. Toss shrimp with Tex-Mex paste on the other side; roast until shrimp reach 74°C, roughly 8–12 minutes.
Warm corn in a skillet with a splash of water until heated through.
Mix cabbage with lime zest, a little juice, mayonnaise and a pinch of sugar.
Combine sour cream, remaining mayonnaise and lime juice for a quick Baja-style sauce.
Warm tortillas and fill with shrimp, peppers, corn and cabbage; finish with Baja sauce and lime wedges.
halal: Verify Tex-Mex paste, flour tortillas and mayonnaise; substitute halal-suitable versions where needed.

title: Cashew Shrimp and Tofu Stir-Fry
steps: Simmer jasmine rice in water until tender, about 12–14 minutes.
Press and cube tofu. Dust with half the cornstarch and pan-fry in a little oil until crisp and golden; set aside.
Chop bok choy, snow peas, green onions, garlic and chili. Stir hoisin, soy-mirin blend, remaining cornstarch, garlic and water into a sauce.
Toast cashews lightly in a dry pan, if desired.
Stir-fry shrimp with snow peas then bok choy until shrimp reach 74°C; add tofu back and toss with sauce until thickened.
Serve over rice, finishing with cashews, green onions and chili.
halal: Original soy-mirin blend can contain alcohol. Use verified alcohol-free soy sauce with vinegar and sugar instead; check hoisin ingredients.

title: Spicy North African Chicken
steps: Preheat oven to 230°C; boil a pot of salted water. Chop zucchini, tomato and parsley; slice olives.
Cook pearl couscous 8–10 minutes, drain and reserve a splash of the cooking water.
Season chicken thighs with half the harissa spice mix. Sear briefly, then finish roasting until 74°C.
Cook zucchini in the pan with remaining harissa; add tomatoes, olives, raisins and verified halal broth concentrate.
Toss couscous into the vegetable mixture with a little reserved cooking liquid and chopped parsley.
Serve roasted chicken over couscous and finish with feta and parsley.
halal: Use halal chicken and broth concentrate; check harissa and feta ingredients.

title: Korean-Style Beef Stir Fry
steps: Rinse the brown rice. Simmer it in approximately 1¾ cups water until the grains are tender, around 25–30 minutes.
While the rice cooks, mince garlic and ginger. Slice the green onions, separating white and green pieces; trim the broccolini.
Sauté broccolini with half the garlic and ginger in a little oil until tender-crisp; transfer to a plate.
Combine ground beef with hoisin, soy sauce, green-onion whites and remaining garlic and ginger.
Brown beef in the same pan, breaking it apart; cook to 71°C and return broccolini to warm through.
Serve beef and broccolini over rice, then scatter green-onion greens and sesame seeds.
halal: Use halal-certified ground beef. Check hoisin sauce and use soy sauce with no alcohol; inspect seasoning labels.

title: Quick Honey-Garlic Soy Organic Chicken
steps: Wash rice and simmer with about 1¼ cups water, covered, 13–15 minutes; rest off heat.
Mince garlic and slice green onions. Mix soy sauce, honey-garlic sauce and half the garlic.
Cut chicken into 2–3 cm chunks; season with salt and pepper.
Heat part of the sesame oil with butter; cook corn until hot. Add some green onion and remaining garlic, then set aside.
Cook chicken in the remaining oil until golden and 74°C, then simmer briefly with the honey-garlic mixture until glossy.
Fluff rice with green onions, then portion corn and saucy chicken over two rice bowls.
halal: Use halal chicken. Original HelloFresh soy sauce ingredient declaration includes alcohol: use verified alcohol-free soy sauce. Check honey-garlic sauce.

title: Smart Golden Shrimp and Coconut Sauce
steps: Bring ⅔ cup water with a little butter to a boil; stir in couscous, cover and rest for five minutes.
Quarter the zucchini, pierce tomatoes and roughly chop spinach.
Toss zucchini and tomatoes with oil, then broil or roast until lightly charred and tender.
Pat shrimp dry and sauté with cumin-turmeric blend until pink, opaque and cooked through; set aside.
Simmer coconut milk, verified stock powder and curry paste until slightly thick, then add cooked shrimp.
Fluff couscous with spinach; top with roasted vegetables, coconut shrimp and crispy shallots.
halal: Check curry paste and stock powder for halal suitability, including alcohol or meat-derived ingredients. Shrimp itself contains no pork.

title: Chili-Garlic Salmon Rice Bowls
steps: Rinse jasmine rice, cover with about 1¼ cups water and simmer 13–15 minutes until tender.
Season salmon, brush with chili-garlic sauce and broil until cooked through to 70°C.
Slice carrot, onion and bok choy while the fish cooks.
Sauté carrots first, then onion and bok choy with sesame oil and a splash of water until crisp-tender.
Stir half the ginger sauce into the vegetables and warm briefly.
Add crispy shallots and remaining sesame oil to rice, then serve with salmon, vegetables and leftover ginger sauce.
halal: Check ginger and chili-garlic sauces for alcohol or other non-halal additions; use halal-suitable alternatives if needed.

title: Greek-Style Shrimp and Feta Bake
steps: Heat oven to 230°C. Cook jasmine rice with about 1¼ cups water in a covered pot.
Mince shallot and garlic; halve tomatoes and finely slice fresh basil.
In a small baking dish, toss tomatoes and shallot with garlic and roasted red-pepper pesto.
Add shrimp and feta to the dish and bake until shrimp are opaque and reach 74°C.
Stir butter through the cooked rice and fluff with a fork.
Serve the warm shrimp-and-feta bake over rice, topped with fresh basil.
halal: Check pesto cheese and feta for microbial or vegetarian rennet, and confirm sauces have no added alcohol.

title: Spicy Korean-Style Chicken
steps: Rinse rice and cook until tender in a covered pot for about 13–15 minutes.
Cut zucchini, carrot and green onions into small pieces. Mix gochujang, soy-mirin blend, sugar and a splash of water.
Season and pan-fry chicken tenders until the centres reach 74°C.
In another pan or after removing the chicken, stir-fry carrot and zucchini with ginger-garlic puree until tender-crisp.
Add the sauce and a cornstarch slurry; simmer until thickened, returning chicken to coat.
Divide rice between bowls, top with vegetables and chicken and finish with green onions.
halal: The original gochujang and soy-mirin blend may contain alcohol. Use halal-certified gochujang, alcohol-free soy sauce and rice vinegar instead; buy halal chicken.

title: Smart Smoky Mustard Chicken Thighs
steps: Heat oven to 220°C. Trim and halve Brussels sprouts; roast with oil until browned and tender.
Dice carrots and boil them with a little verified halal broth until soft; mash with butter and garlic salt.
Thinly slice shallot and mince the garlic.
Season chicken thighs and sear until coloured, then cook fully to 74°C.
Sauté shallot and garlic, then mix in chipotle sauce, whole-grain mustard and a little broth to make a glossy pan sauce.
Serve chicken with carrot mash, roasted sprouts and the smoky mustard sauce.
halal: Buy halal chicken and verified halal broth. Whole-grain mustard can contain white wine vinegar; check label or substitute non-wine vinegar mustard.

title: Smart Vietnamese-Style Marinated Chicken Thighs
steps: Bruise and finely mince lemongrass, then mix it with garlic puree and soy sauce.
Pat chicken thighs dry and pound evenly to roughly 1 cm thickness; coat with marinade.
Slice cucumber, halve tomatoes and chop mint.
Whisk sweet chili sauce, rice vinegar and a little oil to make a salad dressing.
Pan-cook chicken until golden and fully cooked to 74°C, then slice.
Toss greens, tomatoes and cucumber with dressing; add chicken, mint and crispy shallots.
halal: Use halal chicken and alcohol-free soy sauce; check sweet-chili sauce and crispy shallots. The page's optional protein notes reference pork, but the selected ingredient listing here uses chicken.

title: Greek-Style Lemon Chicken Thighs
steps: Heat oven to 220°C. Chop zucchini and bell pepper, zest the lemon and cut it into wedges.
Season the vegetables with the zesty garlic blend and oil, then roast for 15–17 minutes.
Season chicken with dill-garlic blend, sear briefly in a pan and transfer beside vegetables to finish in the oven to 74°C.
Bring halal-certified broth and ⅔ cup water to a boil; remove from heat, stir in couscous and cover for five minutes.
Fluff couscous and stir through roasted vegetables, lemon zest and juice.
Slice chicken over couscous and top with feta and lemon.
halal: Use halal chicken and broth concentrate; check spice blends and feta's enzyme/rennet.

title: Carb Smart Beef Taco Soup
steps: Heat oven to 175°C. Chop bell pepper, tomato and onion; roughly cut cilantro.
Brown ground beef with onion and pepper in a soup pot, cooking the meat to 71°C.
Stir in crushed tomatoes, verified halal beef stock powder, enchilada seasoning, half the Mexican seasoning, cream cheese and water.
Simmer five to seven minutes until the soup thickens slightly and cheese has melted.
Toss tortilla chips with remaining Mexican seasoning and toast briefly in the oven.
Ladle soup into two bowls; garnish with chips, cheddar, fresh tomato and cilantro.
halal: Use halal ground beef. Check beef stock powder and all packaged spice blends; cheddar should contain microbial/vegetarian rennet.

title: Smart Vietnamese-Style Beef Patties
steps: Slice cucumber and carrot, mince garlic and chop green onions.
Toast peanuts in a dry pan until fragrant, then set aside.
Mix ground beef, garlic, soy sauce and Thai seasoning; shape into eight small patties.
Pan-fry patties until browned and cooked through to 71°C.
Whisk half the sweet chili sauce with rice vinegar and oil, then toss greens, cucumber, carrot and green onion with dressing.
Coat patties with remaining sweet chili sauce and serve on salad, topped with roasted peanuts.
halal: Use halal beef and alcohol-free soy sauce. Check Thai seasoning and sweet-chili sauce for alcohol or animal-derived flavourings.

title: SuperQuick Thai Coconut-Curry Salmon Bowls
steps: Start jasmine rice in a covered pot; cook until tender.
Slice bell pepper and trim snap peas. Pat salmon dry and season.
Sear salmon to 70°C, then set aside while preparing the curry.
Stir-fry bell pepper and snap peas with ginger-garlic puree, red curry paste and Thai spice blend.
Add coconut milk and a little soy sauce; simmer briefly and stir in salmon and garlic spread.
Serve coconut salmon and vegetables over rice, scattering chopped cashews on top.
halal: Original soy sauce may contain alcohol; choose alcohol-free soy sauce. Check curry paste, Thai spice blend and garlic spread. This meal is high calorie (1140 kcal per HelloFresh serving).

title: Smoky Adobo Chicken Tacos
steps: Cut mango into strips and finely slice red onion and cilantro. Zest and juice lime.
Mix sour cream with lime zest, lime juice, salt and pepper for a tangy crema.
Combine mango strips, onion, cilantro and remaining lime juice for slaw.
Butterfly chicken breasts and lightly coat with chipotle adobo sauce, adjusting spiciness.
Pan-cook chicken over medium-high heat until browned and cooked to 74°C, then slice thinly.
Warm tortillas; spread mashed avocado, add chicken and mango slaw, and drizzle lime crema.
halal: Use halal chicken and verify chipotles in adobo and sour cream ingredients. HelloFresh did not publish reliable nutrition values for this older recipe.

title: SuperQuick Asian-Inspired Beef Tacos
steps: Brown halal ground beef with ginger-garlic puree, soy-mirin blend and a little oil, cooking to 71°C.
Thinly slice green onions and toss shredded cabbage and carrot with mayonnaise, vinegar and some green onions.
Mix honey with chili-garlic sauce for a spicy drizzle.
Warm flour tortillas just before serving so they stay flexible.
Fill tortillas with cabbage slaw and seasoned beef.
Drizzle hot honey on top and finish with peanuts and remaining green onion.
halal: Soy-mirin blend can contain mirin; replace with alcohol-free soy sauce, rice vinegar and a little sugar. Check mayonnaise, vinegar and tortillas.

title: Spicy Korean-Inspired Chicken Tacos
steps: Thinly slice green onions; pat chicken tenders dry and dust with moo shu seasoning.
Sear chicken in hot sesame oil until golden and cooked to 74°C.
Stir brown sugar, gochujang, soy sauce and a little water into the pan; simmer until chicken is coated.
Whisk mayonnaise, rice vinegar and remaining sesame oil into a dressing; mix with coleslaw and green onions.
Warm flour tortillas in the microwave or a covered skillet just before serving.
Divide chicken among tortillas, then top with creamy sesame slaw.
halal: Choose halal chicken and check tortillas, mayonnaise and seasonings. HelloFresh's gochujang and soy sauce can contain alcohol; use halal-certified gochujang and alcohol-free soy sauce.

title: Creamy Chicken Pasta
steps: Boil a pot of salted water and cook spaghetti until al dente, reserving a cup of cooking water.
Pat chicken dry and cut into bite-sized pieces; chop onion and rinse spinach.
Sear chicken with garlic salt in a little oil until golden and 74°C inside, then set aside.
Soften onion in the pan, stir in cream sauce spice blend, cream and halal-certified chicken broth concentrate.
Add spinach and cooked spaghetti, tossing with a splash of pasta water; return chicken and heat through.
Serve in two bowls and finish with Parmesan; cool and refrigerate leftovers promptly.
halal: Choose halal chicken, alcohol-free halal broth and Parmesan with microbial/vegetarian rennet.

title: Curried Chicken Penne
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook penne until al dente.
Slice chicken into strips and peel carrots into thin half-moons.
Sear chicken in oil until cooked through to 74°C, then temporarily remove.
Stir-fry carrot in the same pan until tender; add tikka sauce and a splash of pasta water.
Fold in spinach, chicken and cooked penne, simmering until coated and spinach wilts.
Serve topped with crispy shallots and divide into two portions.
halal: Use halal chicken and inspect tikka sauce for alcohol or meat-derived ingredients; check crispy shallots.

title: Chicken al Limone and Linguine
steps: Boil salted water for linguine; zest lemon and cut pepper into strips.
Pat chicken breasts dry and season with garlic salt and pepper.
Cook chicken in a skillet, turning until 74°C at the centre; transfer to a clean plate.
Cook linguine in boiling water, reserving some starchy pasta water; sauté pepper in the chicken skillet.
Add cream, lemon zest, lemon juice and a little pasta water to the peppers; wilt spinach.
Toss linguine with creamy lemon sauce, slice chicken and place on top; finish with Parmesan.
halal: Buy halal chicken and cheese with vegetarian/microbial rennet; confirm the packaged cream and seasonings.

title: Chicken Chow Mein-Style Noodles
steps: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces and season with half the moo shu spice blend.
Slice carrot into half-moons and chop Shanghai bok choy into bite-size pieces.
Toast peanuts in a dry pan until fragrant and set them aside.
Cook chow mein noodles in boiling water according to package directions; drain.
Stir-fry chicken to 74°C, then add carrot and bok choy; stir in honey-garlic sauce, vegetarian oyster sauce and remaining spice.
Toss noodles with the chicken and vegetables; sprinkle with peanuts and divide into two bowls.
halal: Use halal chicken and verify vegetarian oyster sauce, honey-garlic sauce and spice blends for alcohol/halal suitability.

title: Butter Chicken Curry with Basmati Rice
steps: Heat oven to 230°C and bring 1¼ cups water to boil. Add basmati rice, cover and simmer 12–14 minutes.
Chop onion and tomatoes; pat chicken thighs dry and cut into pieces.
Brown chicken with Indian spice blend in a little oil until 74°C inside.
Soften onion and garlic in the pan, then stir in chopped tomatoes and tikka sauce; simmer until slightly reduced.
Stir in cream and cooked chicken; gently simmer until the butter chicken sauce coats the meat.
Warm flatbreads in oven and serve with rice and chicken. This is a higher-calorie meal per original listing.
halal: Use halal chicken and halal-suitable tikka sauce and flatbreads; verify spice blends. At 1,250 kcal/serving this is not a low-calorie choice.

title: Dilly Chicken Thighs and Tomato Orzo
steps: Boil salted water and cook the orzo until tender; reserve a little pasta water.
Cut onion and prepare baby spinach; season thighs with dill-garlic spices.
Sear chicken until browned, finish cooking until 74°C and transfer to a plate.
Soften onion in the same pan, add tomato sauce base, halal stock powder and a little pasta water.
Fold in the cooked orzo and spinach; stir until spinach wilts and sauce coats the pasta.
Serve tomato orzo with chicken thighs on top and crumble feta over the bowls.
halal: Choose halal chicken and stock powder. Verify feta rennet and the tomato sauce base.

title: Shrimp Diavolo Linguine

ingredients.name: Crushed tomatoes with garlic and onion

steps: Boil linguine until al dente and save a little pasta water.
Pat shrimp dry, remove any tails, and finely slice the lemon.
Soften chopped onion in a little oil; add chili flakes and Italian seasoning.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer briefly, then stir in spinach until it wilts.
Sauté shrimp separately until pink, opaque and cooked through to 74°C; toss into tomato sauce with linguine.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon, pasta water as needed and Parmesan; serve two portions.
halal: Check Parmesan for microbial/vegetarian rennet. Verify canned tomato sauce and spices contain no cooking wine.

title: Shrimp and Pesto Penne
steps: Cook penne in boiling salted water until al dente; reserve a little pasta water.
Chop tomato and onion; wash spinach and pat shrimp dry.
Toast walnuts briefly in a dry pan and set aside.
Sauté onion, garlic and tomato in oil until fragrant, then add shrimp and cook through to 74°C.
Mix basil pesto, cooked penne, a little pasta water and spinach into the shrimp mixture; warm until greens wilt.
Top both servings with grated Parmesan and toasted walnuts.
halal: Check basil pesto and Parmesan for vegetarian/microbial rennet and packaged sauce for alcohol.

title: Shrimp Teriyaki Dinner
steps: Simmer jasmine rice in about 1¼ cups water until tender, then rest covered.
Slice bell pepper and trim snow peas; pat shrimp dry.
Mix ginger sauce with soy sauce, honey and a splash of water for a teriyaki-style glaze.
Toast sesame seeds in a dry pan, then sauté bell pepper, snow peas and edamame in oil.
Add shrimp and cook until pink, opaque and 74°C; add garlic puree and glaze and simmer briefly.
Serve glazed shrimp and vegetables over rice, topped with sesame seeds.
halal: Use alcohol-free soy sauce and inspect ginger/teriyaki sauces, which may contain cooking wine.

title: Mediterranean-Style Shrimp and Pesto Orzo
steps: Boil orzo in salted water until tender, saving a little cooking water.
Cut bell pepper and zucchini into bite-size pieces, chop parsley and pat shrimp dry.
Sauté bell pepper and zucchini until lightly golden; add garlic puree and Mediterranean spice blend.
Pan-cook shrimp separately until opaque and 74°C, then combine with vegetables.
Toss cooked orzo with sun-dried tomato pesto and a splash of pasta water, followed by the shrimp and vegetables.
Serve with yogurt sauce, feta and fresh parsley.
halal: Check sun-dried tomato pesto and feta for microbial/vegetarian rennet; verify yogurt sauce and spice blend.

title: Garlicky Sun-Dried Tomato Shrimp
steps: Bring salted water to a boil and cook orzo until tender; add peas near the end.
Cut bell pepper into thin strips and pat shrimp dry.
Sauté pepper in a large skillet until softened, then stir in garlic puree.
Add shrimp and cook until opaque and 74°C throughout.
Reduce heat and stir in sun-dried tomato pesto and a splash of cooking water until creamy.
Fold in drained orzo and peas and finish with Parmesan and garlic salt.
halal: Choose sun-dried tomato pesto and Parmesan made with vegetarian/microbial rennet; check sauces for alcohol.

title: Shrimp and Salmon Fusilli

ingredients.name: Crushed tomatoes with garlic and onion

steps: Boil fusilli in a pot of salted water until al dente, then drain.
Cut pepper and rinse spinach; pat salmon and shrimp dry and season with garlic salt.
Cook salmon until the centre reaches 70°C, then cut into bite-size flakes.
Sauté peppers, add crushed tomatoes and Italian seasoning and simmer; fold in spinach.
Cook shrimp separately until opaque and 74°C, then add salmon, shrimp and fusilli to tomato sauce.
Finish with Parmesan and a little balsamic glaze; divide between two bowls.
halal: Check balsamic glaze for wine-derived alcohol if avoiding it; use vegetarian-rennet Parmesan. Salmon and shrimp are the proteins here.

title: Salmon, Shrimp and Zucchini Linguine
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook fresh linguine until just tender; reserve pasta water.
Cut zucchini into half-moons and chop dill; pat shrimp and salmon dry.
Sear salmon in a hot pan until the centre reaches 70°C; remove to a plate and flake into large pieces.
Cook shrimp in the pan until opaque and 74°C; remove. Sauté onion, zucchini and peas with garlic puree.
Add cream, Dijon mustard and halal-suitable vegetable broth concentrate; simmer briefly and thin with pasta water.
Toss linguine with creamy vegetables, shrimp, salmon and dill. This is a very rich 1,290-kcal serving.
halal: Verify Dijon mustard (some contain wine), broth and cream are suitable. Use alcohol-free alternatives; higher calorie than your stated preference.

title: Warm Salmon and Shrimp with Cajun Rice
steps: Rinse basmati rice and cook covered in water with a little Cajun spice until tender.
Dice bell pepper and tomato, slice green onions and zest half the lemon.
Season salmon with Cajun spice and roast or sear to 70°C; set aside.
Sauté aromatics blend and bell pepper until softened, then add shrimp and cook to 74°C.
Stir tomatoes, broth concentrate and a splash of water through the shrimp; simmer until flavours combine.
Spoon over rice and top with salmon, lemon wedges and green onions.
halal: Choose alcohol-free, halal-suitable vegetable broth and check Cajun seasoning for hidden meat flavours.

title: Cajun Salmon and Shrimp
steps: Simmer basmati rice until tender, then fluff and keep warm.
Dice celery, bell pepper, tomato and onion; slice green onions and cut lemon into wedges.
Sprinkle salmon with Cajun seasoning; sear or roast until it reaches 70°C.
Sauté chopped onion, celery and bell pepper in a large pan until softened.
Add shrimp, remaining Cajun spices, broth concentrate and a splash of water, then simmer until shrimp reach 74°C.
Serve the spicy shrimp and vegetables over rice with salmon, fresh tomato, lemon and green onions.
halal: Check Cajun spice and vegetable broth ingredients for halal suitability; no pork is listed.

title: Miso-Honey Glazed Salmon
steps: Cook basmati rice covered until tender.
Trim bok choy, slice bell pepper and green onions, and pat salmon dry.
Combine honey, soy sauce and miso broth concentrate in a small bowl; use alcohol-free soy sauce.
Toast sesame seeds in a clean dry pan, then sauté bell pepper and bok choy until tender-crisp.
Sear salmon with garlic salt and brush in the glaze during the final minutes; cook to 70°C.
Serve salmon on rice with sautéed vegetables, sesame and green onions.
halal: Some soy sauce and miso stock products contain alcohol; select alcohol-free soy sauce and verified halal broth.

title: Baked Salmon and Chips
steps: Heat oven to 230°C. Slice potatoes into thin fries and roast with oil and salt for 25–28 minutes.
Finely chop dill pickles and dill; mince garlic and zest lemon.
Mix mayonnaise with pickles, lemon zest, dill and part of the Worcestershire sauce for tartar dip.
Pat salmon dry and roast on a lined tray until its centre reaches 70°C.
Quickly sauté snap peas with garlic until bright green; squeeze on a little lemon.
Serve roasted salmon with potato fries, snap peas and the pickle-dill tartar sauce.
halal: Worcestershire can contain anchovy (fish) or other ingredients; check brand and make sure mayonnaise is halal-suitable.

title: Zesty Garlic Salmon with Tomato Linguine

ingredients.name: Crushed tomatoes with garlic and onion

steps: Boil salted water and cook linguine until tender; drain and save some cooking water.
Pat salmon dry and rub with zesty garlic spice, salt and pepper.
Sear salmon in oil until nicely browned and the centre reaches 70°C.
Warm crushed tomatoes in the skillet with a little pasta water until simmering.
Stir spinach into tomato sauce until wilted, then toss with the cooked linguine.
Portion tomato linguine into two bowls, place salmon on top and crumble feta over each.
halal: Check feta for microbial/vegetarian rennet and canned tomato sauce for wine or meat ingredients.

title: Panko-Crusted Baked Salmon
steps: Heat oven to 230°C; boil salted water for orzo and chop chives.
Stir panko with mayonnaise, sun-dried tomato pesto and a little zesty garlic seasoning.
Place salmon on a lined baking sheet and press pesto-panko topping onto the surface.
Bake salmon until crust is golden and fish reaches 70°C.
Cook orzo, drain, and fold in baby spinach until softened; season with the remaining garlic blend.
Serve salmon over orzo, crumbling feta and scattering chives over each plate.
halal: Check pesto and feta cheese for vegetarian/microbial rennet; verify mayonnaise and panko.

title: Sushi-Inspired Gingery Salmon Bowls
steps: Rinse sticky rice and cook covered following package directions, keeping it moist for a bowl.
Cut broccoli into florets, shred cabbage, slice green onion and cube avocado.
Toss cabbage with seasoned rice vinegar and a pinch of sugar; let it stand.
Cook broccoli and edamame in a hot pan with sesame oil until crisp-tender.
Sear salmon until the centre reaches 70°C; brush or toss with the ginger sauce.
Build bowls with rice, cabbage, vegetables, avocado and salmon; drizzle spicy mayo and sprinkle sesame and green onion.
halal: Check ginger sauce, seasoned vinegar and spicy mayo for alcohol and other unsuitable ingredients. This meal is 980 kcal per serving.

title: Velvety Tuscan Salmon Linguine
steps: Boil water for fresh linguine; chop shallot, mince garlic, halve tomatoes and rinse spinach.
Season salmon with zesty garlic blend and roast or sear until it reaches 70°C.
Cook linguine in salted boiling water; drain, reserving starchy cooking water.
Sauté shallot, garlic and tomatoes in a little butter until fragrant.
Add cream, spinach and some pasta water; simmer until lightly reduced, then add Parmesan.
Coat linguine in creamy sauce and serve salmon over it. This is a rich, high-calorie choice.
halal: Use Parmesan with microbial/vegetarian rennet and check seasonings; 1,290 kcal/serving is not a low-calorie dish.

title: Sticky Ginger Beef and Rice Bowls
steps: Rinse jasmine rice and toast briefly with half the ginger-garlic puree in oil; add water and simmer covered.
Slice radishes and snap peas and set carrots in a small bowl.
Toss carrot and radish with rice vinegar, honey and a little salt to quick-pickle.
Brown halal ground beef with remaining ginger-garlic puree and soy sauce until fully cooked to 71°C.
Mix a little soy sauce into mayonnaise; quickly sauté sugar snap peas.
Serve beef, snap peas and pickled vegetables over rice, topping with soy-mayo and crispy shallots.
halal: Use halal beef and alcohol-free soy sauce; check mayonnaise, crispy shallots and rice vinegar.

title: Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato Pesto Chicken Pasta

ingredients.name: White cooking wine (original recipe; replace for halal)

steps: Cook fresh linguine in salted boiling water until just tender; reserve some pasta water.
Season halal chicken with garlic salt; sear in a hot skillet until golden and the centre reaches 74°C.
Soften chopped onion and baby tomatoes in the same pan with a little butter.
Add sun-dried tomato pesto, cream, capers and a splash of halal vegetable broth plus lemon juice instead of the original wine.
Stir in spinach until wilted, then toss through the linguine and Parmesan, adding pasta water as needed.
Slice chicken over creamy pasta. Original recipe uses cooking wine; this home substitution changes flavour and published nutrition.
halal: Original HelloFresh recipe contains 4 tbsp WHITE COOKING WINE. Replace with halal vegetable broth and lemon juice. Use halal chicken and vegetarian/microbial-rennet Parmesan. This is a 1,050 kcal/serving recipe, so it does not meet a low-calorie goal.

title: Creamy Chicken Pasta with Broccoli
steps: Boil a pot of salted water for gemelli. Zest lemon and cut it into wedges.
Cut broccoli into small florets, mince garlic and chop basil; pat chicken dry.
Cook gemelli until almost tender; add broccoli and peas during the final couple of minutes.
Season chicken and sear in a little oil until browned and 74°C in the centre; cut into strips.
Stir cream cheese, halal chicken stock concentrate and garlic into pasta with a splash of cooking water until creamy.
Toss with basil, add lemon juice to taste, and top with chicken and Parmesan. Double-check amounts on the archived US recipe.
halal: Use halal chicken and stock concentrate; choose Parmesan made with microbial/vegetarian rennet. Older US recipe-page unit formatting is ambiguous—review package quantities.

title: Chicken Penne al Limone
steps: Boil salted water and cook penne until al dente; save some cooking liquid.
Slice zucchini into half-moons, mince garlic and chop parsley; zest and halve lemon.
Season chicken strips and sauté in a hot oiled skillet until cooked through to 74°C.
Cook zucchini until lightly browned, then add garlic and the cream sauce base.
Stir in lemon zest, a squeeze of juice and a little pasta water, then toss with penne.
Divide between bowls, add chicken and top with Parmesan and fresh parsley.
halal: Buy halal chicken and verify cream sauce and Parmesan rennet. A squeeze of lemon replaces any alcohol-containing seasoning.

title: Organic Chicken & Mushroom Penne
steps: Boil penne in salted water until tender, then reserve some pasta water.
Slice mushrooms, tomato and scallions; pat chicken cutlets dry and season.
Cook chicken in a hot skillet until its centre reaches 74°C, then slice into pieces.
Brown mushrooms with garlic powder and mushroom stock, adding a splash of pasta water.
Stir in cream cheese, truffle seasoning, cooked penne and grated Parmesan until glossy.
Top with sliced chicken, chopped scallions, tomato and a sprinkle of lightly toasted panko.
halal: Use halal-certified chicken and check mushroom stock concentrate, truffle blend, cheese rennet and panko. US listing's protein figure appears unreliable, so left unspecified.

title: German-Style Smoky Chicken Penne
steps: Boil penne in salted water until al dente, reserving some pasta water.
Cut zucchini into half-moons, chop chives and zest the lemon.
Season halal dark-meat chicken and sear until golden and 74°C inside.
Sauté zucchini in the same pan. Add the vegetable stock concentrate and a splash of water.
Stir in cream cheese and smoky mustard to make a smooth sauce, then add pasta and chicken.
Finish with chopped chives and lemon juice. Divide into two bowls.
halal: Use halal chicken and alcohol-free smoky mustard (some mustards contain wine); check stock concentrate and cream cheese.

title: Garlic Chicken & Creamy Lemon Linguine
steps: Cook linguine in salted boiling water until tender, saving a little starchy water.
Slice scallions and zest the lemon, then pat chicken cutlets dry.
Season chicken with garlic powder, salt and pepper; pan-cook until the centre reaches 74°C.
Sauté scallions with onion paste, then add peas and a little pasta water.
Stir in cream sauce base, lemon zest and some juice, then toss the linguine through it.
Slice chicken, lay it over the creamy linguine and finish with scallions and lemon wedges.
halal: Use halal chicken and check cream sauce base and Vidalia onion paste for alcohol or meat flavours.

title: Shrimp Spaghetti with a Kick
steps: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente and save a little pasta water.
Slice zucchini into half-moons and finely chop chili pepper; pat shrimp dry.
Sauté zucchini in some of the garlic-herb butter until golden; remove to a plate.
Add shrimp and the remaining garlic-herb butter to the pan; cook until pink and 74°C.
Toss spaghetti, cooked zucchini and chili into the pan with pasta water to make a silky coating.
Top each plate with Parmesan and season to taste. Start with less chili if sensitive to heat.
halal: Shrimp itself contains no pork; check garlic-herb butter seasoning and Parmesan for vegetarian/microbial rennet.

title: Roasted Italian Panko-Crusted Salmon
steps: Heat oven to 220°C. Bring salted water to a boil for orzo and pat salmon dry.
Combine panko, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, a little oil and lemon zest into a crust mixture.
Place salmon on a lined sheet and press the panko mixture over the fillets; roast until cooked to 70°C.
Boil orzo until tender and add peas near the end; drain, reserving a little cooking liquid.
Warm stock concentrate, cream cheese, chopped sun-dried tomatoes and lemon juice with orzo to make a creamy base.
Serve salmon over pea-orzo with green goddess dressing and Dijon on the side. Original listing is 1,280 kcal per serving.
halal: Use halal-suitable veggie stock and green-goddess dressing; verify Dijon for wine, cheese ingredients and panko. This high-calorie recipe may not match a low-calorie goal.
